title: Watch Wrist Time Log Wear Hours Leaderboard
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:wristtime wear_hours=*
| stats sum(wear_hours) as total_value, avg(wear_hours) as avg_value by reference_number
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks reference values by total and average wear hours across watch wrist-time log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `wear_hours` values for each watch wrist-time log event and review total and average wear hours by reference.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total wear hours.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which reference shows the biggest wear hours numbers in your watch wrist-time log data.
